correctness.rationale: The source proof reduces the strictly convex centered sum of squares on the finite Lipschitz polytope (modulo constants) to vertices with connected tight-pair graph. Every cross-cluster tight pair for 0<s<1 has consistent orientation, forcing values 0,s on one cluster and 1-s,1 on the other. The two-sided exchange gains 2s(1-s), ruling out simultaneous splits; comparison rules out a split confined to the smaller cluster. The remaining exact candidates F_k=L+ks²-(L+ks)²/N are all feasible. Completing the square yields nearest-integer k, global optimizer classification and phase crossings s_j=2L/(N-2j-1) with right-minus-left slope 2L/N. Equilateral s=1 reduces to balanced binary partitions. I independently recomputed 144 rational parameter cases and the completed-square expression; finite checks corroborate but do not prove the all-size statement. Domains: integer m,n>=2, real 0<s<=1, real observables, uniform atoms, counting-variance normalization.
